2115910608818425934.en_summary: AMZN -6% AH after 3Q net sales missed and Operating Income beat ests, while AWS revs beat. 4Q guidance for Revs and Operating Income below expectations. 2026FY CapEx guidance of $220B re-affirmed even as 3Q Capex high. 3Q: Revs $201.9B vs $202.3B, EPS $1.89 vs $1.97, OpInc $28.1B vs $26.1B, CapEx $77.3B vs $58.8B, AWS $46.0B vs $45.7B, Online stores $68.5B vs $69.6B, Ads $19.6B vs $20.9B. 4Q: Net sales $240-247B vs $244.5B, OpInc $28.5-33.5B vs $33B.
2115910608818425934.zh_summary: 亞馬遜盤後下跌6%，第三季淨銷售額未達預期、營業收入超預期，AWS收入超預期。第四季營收和營業收入指引低於預期。2026財年資本支出指引2200億美元獲重申，儘管第三季資本支出較高。第三季：營收2019億對預期2023億，EPS 1.89對1.97，營業收入281億對261億，資本支出773億對588億，AWS 460億對457億。第四季：淨銷售2400-2470億對預期2445億，營業收入285-335億對330億。

2115909665100022002.en_summary: AMZN (down 6%) inline Dec guide does not address the central question: How will they navigate a world where consumers increasingly use bots as the starting point for commerce? Quoted prior: Google results warning to Amazon investors. Street likely discounts favorable Sep results and inline Dec guide due to long-term (H2 2027) risk from personalized bots. Amazon wins on finding what you want, speed, trust; first under attack.
2115909665100022002.zh_summary: 亞馬遜（下跌6%）的十二月指引未解決核心問題：如何應對消費者日益使用機器人作為商業起點的世界？引用先前：谷歌業績對亞馬遜投資者是警告。市場可能因個性化機器人帶來的長期（2027年下半年）風險而折現有利的九月業績和符合預期的十二月指引。亞馬遜勝在找到所需、速度和信任，第一項正受攻擊。

ticker_notes.AMZN: 機器人作為購物起點對亞馬遜搜尋優勢構成長期風險
